newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel stock down in Paris again.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel stock down in Paris again.

text.p: Shares in Anglo-French Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA /Plc fell heavily on the Paris stock exchange bourse for a second day running on Wednesday in the wake of the announcement of its debt restructuring deal.
The stock was down 11.98 percent at 7.35 francs at 0857 GMT after hitting a low of 7.30 francs with nearly 4.5 million shares traded, while the CAC-40 leading share index was down 0.08 percent.
Eurotunnel shares requoted on Tuesday at nine francs, down 1.64 percent from the level of 9.15 francs where they had been suspended on September 15 ahead of the restructuring announcement.

The share fell sharply on Tuesday to close at 8.35 francs amid market blues over the restructuring terms, with one analyst highlighting disappointment that the banks were getting 10.40 francs a share in an eight-billion-franc debt-for-equity deal. The market had been looking for 12-15 francs a share, the analyst said. Another analysts had said the shares remained a risky investment.
In London, the share was trading at 91 pence at 0909 GMT, down 14 p with just under a million shares traded.
